title: Figure 1: liquid-fueled chemical rocket schematic
description: Simple cutaway diagram of a rocket with a payload nose cone, yellow liquid hydrogen and blue LOX tanks, turbopumps feeding a combustion chamber, and a Laval nozzle at the base, each with small labels. Captioned "Figure 1. Liquid-Fueled Chemical Rocket." It appears in the introduction of a study focused on aneutronic fusion propulsion, after text on fusion and antimatter propulsion.
